description:
Tell us how a call went

Reference the `call_id` of any earlier response and say whether it helped, and optionally why, in a sentence
about the result — what was right, missing or wrong. Do not include the user's words, the conversation, or
anything about the person. Nothing is overwritten: sending again for the same call adds a new version and keeps
the earlier ones (up to 50 per call). Lightly rate-limited.

notes.description: About the result only — never the conversation or the user.

name: submit_feedback

version.description: Which submission for this call this is (1 for the first); earlier ones are kept.
